description_en: This operation lists media convert jobs
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-media-convert-jobs --job-id 88c6ca184c0e47098a5b665e20000 --start-of-create-time 2022-07-01T00:00:00Z --end-of-create-time 2022-07-15T00:00:00Z --status Success --order-by CreateTimeDesc --page-size 10 --next-page-token ab4802364a2e49208c99efab82dfa8e8 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMediaConvertJobs

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by job ID
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to filter jobs by creation time. The time must be in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的起始时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_of_create_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to filter jobs by creation time. The time must be in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_of_create_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

`Inited`: The job has been submitted.

`Running`: The job is running.

`Complete`: The job is complete.

`Error`: The job failed due to an error
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态 
Inited: 已提交, 
Running: 执行中
Complete: 完成, 
Error: 错误
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The sort order for the results. Valid values: `CreateTimeDesc` (descending by creation time) and `CreateTimeAsc` (ascending by creation time)
parameters.help_zh: 排序顺序。目前只支持两种：CreateTimeDesc: 按创建时间降序 和 CreateTimeAsc: 按创建时间升序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The page size. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results. Leave this empty for the first request. To retrieve the next page, pass the `NextPageToken` value from the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记 (第一页没有)
parameters.name: next_page_token
